Our Expertise in WordPress Development

WordPress Website Design and Development

Mobilunity’s WP developers will embrace the entire process of your website creation, from selecting the domain name to adding the necessary buttons. The experts you hire with us know how colors communicate with your audience and understand how to make the logical structure of elements on a page. 

Our coders also embrace backend programming and database management. They set advanced security configurations and make the entire system work smoothly. This way, you get a good-looking, informative, and responsive website that attracts customers.

WordPress Theme Customization

Do you want your WP website to demonstrate your unique branding, provide easy navigation, and get a better SEO score? Hire WordPress theme developers with Mobilunity. With them, you can go beyond the default theme appearance customization or block editing. 

WP programmers will edit your theme’s code to add the required functionality. For instance, this will let you add brand-introducing elements like hero images and background videos. With professionals, you follow the WP coding standards and best practices of website customization.

Plugin Development for WordPress

WordPress plugins are available pieces of code developed by other programmers. An extensive plugin library makes this content management system (CMS) applicable to any content type. However, you’ll need to hire WordPress plugin developers to leverage the pre-written codes or create your own ones.  

That’s because knowing PHP, HTML/CSS, JavaScript, jQuery, and WordPress API is vital for building a plugin. Every Mobilunity’s WordPress engineer has it all and can quickly write, test, and debug the code to ensure its proper functioning.

WordPress Website Migration and Upgrades

Do you want to move your website to WordPress? Or are you already on WP and just need to transfer your website to a new server, domain, or hosting provider? Hire professional WordPress developer with Mobilunity to realize this quickly.

A specialist will back up your content and functionality, pick the time with the lowest traffic, and minimize downtime. A WordPress programmer for hire will run the migrated web pages in maintenance mode and create a notification page for visitors.

Security Enhancements for WordPress

Protecting your visitors’ sensitive data is essential, so improving your website security non-stop is a must. The best way to do that is to hire WordPress programmers with years of experience in the field. 

Running timely version updates, setting strong admin passwords, enabling URL lockdowns, using original themes, and encrypting data are only a few tasks your WordPress developer for hire will complete. They also create security plugins and remove unused ones to minimize your website’s vulnerability.

WordPress Consulting

When you need advice on WordPress, hire developer with the required expertise. Mobilunity’s WP engineers are ready to embrace minor and complex fixes for your website. They’ll guide you on your web resource’s design, development, maintenance, support, or optimization.

You can hire WP developer for several hours. Also, we offer full and flex cooperation so you can achieve your goals. Our engineers will launch or redesign your site, develop plugins, maintain your web resources, etc.

{services}

Our Portfolio of WordPress Expertise

Custom Theme Development

Sometimes, you can’t get the right look of your website even with thousands of WordPress themes. That’s when you need to hire WordPress developer and build your own. Professionals know how to create the structure, store the visual information, and add customized functions to make your site look unique.

Plugin Customization

When you need to include specific functions triggered by users’ actions, WordPress plugin developers for hire will help. Experienced coders can extend the functionality of existing plugins and build new ones. These tasks require professionalism and proper backup. That’s because even one mistake can affect the work of your website.

Responsive Design

Responsiveness, or the ability to adapt to different screen sizes, is one of the core features of a website. And a WordPress website programmer keeps in mind the mobile-first approach and aims for minimalism. Such an expert will highlight or hide some content and use specific design patterns to fit users’ contexts.

WooCommerce Integration

This WordPress-based e-commerce platform boasts integration with many ERP platforms and top online retailers. These include Microsoft Dynamics, Oracle, SAP Business One, AliExpress, Amazon, eBay, and Walmart. Still, it’s essential to hire WooCommerce WordPress developer to connect solutions. With this integration, you’ll automate drop-shipping, better manage leads, process orders faster, etc.

WordPress Multisite Setups

Our WordPress programmers for hire will help you install and manage several websites on a single dashboard. This feature is helpful for using subdomains for different teams, offices, or departments. Your web developer WordPress will help you manage websites more efficiently and get better control over them.

WordPress Security and Performance

When you hire expert WordPress developers, you mitigate the risk of your website getting hacked. These specialists will continuously monitor possible vulnerabilities, protecting your reputation and the data of your customers. The best WordPress programmers will run regular updates, create backups, set user permissions and strong passwords, and integrate security plugins.

API Integration With Third-Party Services

Only a few websites operate without engaging external applications, and WordPress APIs link your web pages with third-party services. For these integrations, you’ll need to hire website WordPress developer. They’ll select the proper method and data format to install, configure, and test APIs. Then, your dedicated WordPress programmer for hire will ensure the displayed data is correct.

Collaborate With WordPress Developers For Customized Solutions!

Partner with us to leverage the power of WordPress and drive your online presence to new heights. Let’s work together to create a customized WordPress solution that exceeds your expectations.

Get in touch

Our Cooperation Models

Dedicated WordPress Developer

If you need to hire full time WordPress developer or a dedicated squad for your project, choose this option. Within several weeks, we’ll assemble a small, mid-size, or large web development team. Our managers will provide each team member with the required hardware and software and arrange office space and infrastructure. 

Mobilunity will handle all the back-office issues for a fixed monthly fee once you hire remote dedicated WordPress developers with us. You set tasks for your team while we care about complying with local regulations, transferring payrolls, formalizing vacations, etc. This cooperation format lets you stay focused on work while having a dev team.

Hire Dedicated WordPress Developer

FLEX WordPress Developers

Small or low-load web development projects don’t always require full dedication from programmers. In this case, you can hire WordPress web developers for as many hours a week as you need. This model doesn’t require long-term commitments from you and offers no limitations. You won’t need to pay the full-time fee but cover only the hours worked.

This format works best once you need several working hours of a skilled WP coder or need to enhance your in-house team. Also, if you lack the budget for hiring a full-time WordPress developer hire this expert on an hourly basis. You won’t cover office rentals, equipment, or other overheads.

HIRE FLEX WORDPRESS DEVELOPERS

Benefits of Working with Mobilunity

Certified WordPress Developers

Mobilunity has demanding requirements for candidates. We want to ensure you hire certified WordPress developers for your projects. Though WordPress does not issue official certificates to engineers, our recruiters ensure applicants take professional WP courses. Udemy, Coursera, HubSpot, Codefinity, and LinkedIn are a few organizations that offer high-quality education. 

However, WordPress programming requires other skills like PHP, HTML, and CSS, so we value these certifications, too. Also, our recruiters thoroughly explore candidates’ past projects and select only those with the best-matching experience. In addition, Mobilunity assesses applicants’ soft skills to ensure your future teammates share your values.

Competitive Prices

Whether you hire WordPress Genesis developers or other coders with specific skills, you can do that cost-effectively. Once you need to hire your coder in a particular country, we’ll check all the ins and outs to find a candidate for an optimized cost. Mobilunity’s recruiters will analyze the local market, check attractive offers, and estimate competitive salaries for your specialist.

However, the cost might be significantly lower once you hire dedicated WordPress developers remotely. That’s because we can search for coders in offshore destinations. We hire talented coders in evolving IT hubs — countries with lower costs of living and, thus, lower salaries.

Practical and Scalable Solutions

From our first communication, we’ll do our best to deliver optimized solutions. Mobilunity’s specialists will advise how to hire a WordPress developer or a web development team within your project scope, timeframes, and budget. We’ll employ coders who meet your tech requirements and have a similar mindset and attitude to work. 

Moreover, you can always cut or grow your team as your project dictates. By offering scalable solutions, we remain your reliable partner. The practical part of our cooperation is that we free you from HR, accounting, and administrative tasks related to your team. You devote more time to your project, and we ensure your smooth operation.

Proactive and Clear Communication

The Mobilunity team will always be transparent during our cooperation. At the stage of building your team, we’ll keep you updated about every next step we make. Whether it’s selecting candidates for the long list, running interviews, reporting about rejections, etc., we’ll inform you on time. 

We follow the same approach after we hire WordPress developer online or offline for you, too. Our PM managers will regularly give feedback about the project, while administrators will let you know about critical events in your team or issues that arise. We believe that effective collaboration requires proactive communication.

How to Hire a WordPress Developer with Mobilunity

{01}

Determine Your Needs

Think of the volume of WordPress developer services you require. Will you need two senior WP coders or five mid-level ones? What are the preliminary timeframes of your project, and will you need more people as it matures? Which time zone will be comfortable for you, and which destination do you prefer?

{02}

Get in Touch With Us Using the Form Below

Put your answers on the web form and wait until our manager calls. (It might happen within a few hours). You’ll discuss your query and agree on the preliminary team composition, budget, deadlines, and future cooperation formats with your WP developers. Our specialists will advise on the best solutions for you.

{03}

Receive Estimate and Offer From Us

Mobilunity will take several working days for research and analysis of the market. We’ll check our databases and job portals, explore competitive payrolls, and learn what engages the WordPress specialists we target. Then, we’ll calculate what you’ll have to spend to hire WordPress plugins developer or a dev team and send you an offer. Once you accept it, we’ll start sourcing resumes.

{04}

Interviewing Candidates

Once you see the long list of candidates and pick the most appealing CVs, we’ll start arranging HR and tech interviews with those WordPress programmers for hire. You can join us at any moment or engage only at the final stages of the selection. This stage ends when we get signed job offers.

{05}

Start Your Cooperation

Now, we can hire WordPress plugin developer or your dedicated team of WP engineers. Our specialists get non-disclosure and cooperation agreements with coders signed. They also arrange the working space and equipment for your coders and onboard them. That day, your team is under your functional control and ready to complete your tasks.

FAQs on Hiring WordPress Developers

What will my WordPress programmer for hire do?

You hire WordPress developers to build, customize, and maintain websites based on the WordPress CMS platform. These experts can customize your current website or create a new one from scratch. They migrate web pages to WordPress, optimize their SEO ranking, monitor vulnerabilities, connect external services, etc. So, when you hire WordPress specialist, they handle everything related to your website and content.

Can you provide support for WordPress developer technical interviews?

Yes, we offer specialized support for WordPress developer technical interviews for an additional fee. We arrange interviews with leading experts in WordPress, ideal for teams needing expertise in WordPress development and customization. You will be provided with a detailed report and feedback from the interviewer, aiding your decision-making process.

What skills should I look for when I hire a WordPress programmer?

This expert should know HTML and CSS. JavaScript (client-side) and PHP (server-side) programming languages are also a must. Hire PHP WordPress developers with experience in creating e-commerce platforms and SEO optimization. Hire JavaScript WordPress developers who follow web development standards, monitor trends, and are familiar with responsive design.

How do you assess the expertise of a WP app developer?

When you hire offshore WordPress developers, check their portfolio first. This way, if you hire WordPress WooCommerce developer, explore which payment gateways, shipping options, and other e-shop functionalities this specialist has customized. Ask about principles they used for developing themes and improving user experience. Learn how they managed troubleshooting and SEO optimization. Test their configuration skills and data management approaches.

How much does it cost to hire a WordPress developer?

If you need hire WordPress developer in the US, be prepared to pay $60,000-$100,000 a year. Once you employ a WP engine developer program from Germany, the cost will be $23,000-$54,000. You can spend from $15 to $100 per hour once you hire freelance WordPress developer. So, the total cost will depend on a coder’s location, skills, and experience.

Is it practical to hire remote WordPress developers?

We know many companies that hire remote JavaScript WordPress developers, and their web development teams boast high performance. Among the cons of hiring programmers offshore are lower salaries and access to more top-skilled experts. However, you’ll need to hire remote PHP WordPress developers with a proactive communication approach and the ability to work independently. Also, set clear milestones and use advanced project management tools.

Why should I hire a professional WordPress developer?

A web development expert will make your website more engaging, fast-performing, and secure. You’ll get better SEO rankings, which will expose your web resource to more users. Catchy design and organic promotion will eventually grow your conversions. Generating traffic will require more endurance from your website, which a WordPress developer for hire will ensure. So, when you hire WordPress website developer, you invest in your success.

Can WordPress developers for hire also handle my site maintenance and security?

Sure. If, for instance, you hire Enfold WordPress developers, these professionals won’t only customize this multi-purpose theme for your needs. Most WordPress engineers develop web solutions and maintain them. They run regular updates and backups, add and remove plugins, optimize performance, and eliminate site vulnerabilities. So, it’s beneficial to hire remote WordPress developer with maintenance and security expertise.

How do I communicate my requirements to WordPress programmers?

Even when you hire best WordPress developer, you’ll need to clearly explain your business needs. Cooperation usually starts with a project brief that describes your objectives, target audience, website features, and design preferences with examples. You’ll need to discuss budgets and agree on deadlines. Regular check-ins will help to align the expectations with results.
